house_style: Painterly realistic illustration for a high school chemistry mystery: cool daylight, slate blues and soft grays with a few warm highlights, calm and quiet, deserted. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no frame.
style: A backdrop shown behind the case card under a 70 percent dark overlay.

assets.name: phm-prep-room
assets.prompt: A school chemistry prep room after a small flood: a wooden shelf of plain clear glass bottles with blank white labels, a damp tiled floor with a few shallow puddles reflecting the light, a window with soft daylight, empty and quiet.

assets.name: phm-bench

assets.name: phm-bottle

assets.name: phm-beaker
assets.prompt: Empty clear glass laboratory beaker, pouring lip on left, straight front view, broad elliptical rim. Cool daylight from upper left, neutral pale blue glass highlights. Repair of the original cutout: preserve silhouette and glass geometry; remove green and magenta key fringes.
assets.review: Repaired chromatic key fringes; native alpha preserved.
